enforcedBy: the naming gate, which refuses a filename whose last segment before the extension is an undeclared tag or differs from its folder's tag

check.population: every filename whose concern slot holds the tag, and the folder holding each such file
check.freshness: a verdict stands until a file carrying the tag is created, moved or renamed, or the declared vocabulary changes
check.refusal: the lint run fails a file whose tag is undeclared or disagrees with its folder
check.observation: each filename parsed by position against the declared concern vocabulary
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: a suite lints a file whose tag is undeclared and one whose tag differs from its folder, and passes a conforming file
check.authority: the declared concern vocabulary, which a filename's tag and its folder conform to

records.name: Entrypoint Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file a runtime starts from, which reads its arguments and hands control to the code behind it, filed in an entrypoints folder.

records.name: Bootstrapper Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that assembles the system's parts in order before it serves anything, filed in a bootstrappers folder.

records.name: Initializer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that prepares one component's starting state, filed in an initializers folder.

records.name: Activator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that switches a prepared component into its active state when its trigger arrives, filed in an activators folder.

records.name: Lifecycle Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that governs how a component starts, pauses, resumes and stops, filed in a lifecycle folder.

records.name: Lifecycle-Hook Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that runs at one named point of a component's lifecycle, filed in a lifecycle-hooks folder.

records.name: Startup Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that runs the work a process must finish before it accepts any, filed in a startup folder.

records.name: Warmup Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that primes caches and connections so the first real request runs at normal speed, filed in a warmup folder.

records.name: Draining Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that lets in-flight work finish while refusing new work before a stop, filed in a draining folder.

records.name: Shutdown Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that stops a process in an order that loses no committed work, filed in a shutdown folder.

records.name: Teardown Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that removes what a setup created, such as fixtures or temporary resources, filed in a teardown folder.

records.name: Disposal Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that releases the resources an object holds when the object is no longer used, filed in a disposal folder.

records.name: Cleanup Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that removes leftover state a finished operation leaves behind, filed in a cleanup folder.

records.name: Finalizer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that runs last work on an object as the runtime reclaims it, filed in a finalizers folder.

records.name: Runtime Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that provides the environment other code executes inside, filed in a runtimes folder.

records.name: Engine Tag

distinctFrom.reason: An engine runs the loop that advances a system, while a step is one advance within it.

records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that runs the central loop advancing a system's state, filed in an engines folder.

records.name: Executor Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that runs submitted work on the resources it manages, filed in an executors folder.

records.name: Evaluator Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that computes the value of an expression or a rule against given inputs, filed in an evaluators folder.

records.name: Interpreter Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that executes a program by walking its representation directly, filed in an interpreters folder.

records.name: Scheduler Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that decides when each piece of work runs, filed in a schedulers folder.

records.name: Worker Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that runs work on its own thread or process apart from the caller, filed in a workers folder.

records.name: Future Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a handle to a result that is not computed yet, filed in a futures folder.

records.name: Promise Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that settles an asynchronous result once, as fulfilled or rejected, filed in a promises folder.

records.name: Queue Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds items in arrival order until a consumer takes them, filed in a queues folder.

records.name: Channel Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that carries messages between two parties of a concurrent program, filed in a channels folder.

records.name: Pipe Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that connects one stage's output directly to the next stage's input as a byte or item stream, filed in a pipes folder.

records.name: Mailbox Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds the messages addressed to one actor until it processes them, filed in a mailboxes folder.

records.name: Pool Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that keeps reusable instances and lends them out instead of creating new ones, filed in a pools folder.

records.name: Memory Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds what an agent or a process remembers between steps, filed in a memory folder.

records.name: Heap Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that keeps items ordered so the highest-priority one is always taken first, filed in a heaps folder.

records.name: Handle Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines an opaque reference to a resource another part of the system owns, filed in a handles folder.

records.name: Clock Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that supplies the current time through one replaceable source, filed in a clocks folder.

records.name: Timer Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that runs work after a delay or at a fixed rate, filed in a timers folder.

records.name: Timeout Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that abandons an operation that runs past its allowed time, filed in a timeouts folder.

records.name: Deadline Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that carries the absolute time by which a piece of work must finish, filed in a deadlines folder.

records.name: Delay Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defers an action by a computed amount of time, filed in a delays folder.

records.name: Period Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a named span of calendar time such as a billing month, filed in a periods folder.

records.name: Window Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that groups events into bounded spans of time for aggregation, filed in a windows folder.

records.name: Recurrence Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that defines a rule for repeating an event in time, filed in a recurrences folder.

records.name: Cron Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that holds a schedule written as a cron expression, filed in a crons folder.

records.name: Calendar Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that answers which days count, such as working days and holidays, filed in a calendars folder.

records.name: Timezone Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that converts times between zones and their offsets, filed in a timezones folder.

records.name: Timestamp Tag
records.definition: A formal definition of the tag for a file that creates, parses or compares recorded instants in time, filed in a timestamps folder.
